item.title: Hyslip named Player of the Game - Spring River Chronicle
item.description: Highland Rebel Owen Hyslip was named Player of the Game in the Rebels win 69-67 win over Lincoln in the recent Ronnie Brogdon Bad Boy Mowers Invitational Tournament at Highland. Hyslip is pictured with former Highland teacher, coach, principal and superintendent, the tournament’s namesake Ronnie Brogdon.
